newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas drifts lower on weather, technicals - Feb 13.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas drifts lower on weather, technicals - Feb 13.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub gas futures drifted lower early Thursday, pressured by technical selling, moderating weather forecasts and ample storage inventories, sources said.
By 1100 EST, March slipped five cents to $2.04 per mmBtu. April further narrowed its discount to March, falling 3.2 cents to $2.02. Other months were mostly lower.

"The market has been flipping back into contango. We broke a big trendline last night in ACCESS," a Houston trader said, noting March's failure to rally above the $2.08 level will likely lead to more softening in the near term.
